svg.text: THE CARTRIDGE IS LOGGED DORMANT. LOAD DOES NOT RETURN TO AMBIENT.
EVERY CELL IN THE DORMANT WINDOW SITS ABOVE 0.24.
THE DECOMMISSIONED BUFFER IS STILL WARM. THE CORE IS WARMER.
LOAD IS A NORMALIZED COGNITION MEASURE RECORDED ON THE CARTRIDGE SEAT.
DORMANCY HERE IS THE ABSENCE OF A MANNED SHIFT, NOT THE ABSENCE OF LOAD.
